'''A [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]''' was created from the remnants of several broken [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]]. It was wielded by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] and was very rare.

==Behind the scenes==
Players on [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] could obtain this item by going to JointheJedi.com and clicking on the ''Clone Wars Adventures'' icon. The lightsaber has a [[Color/Legends|purple]] hilt and a purple [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] with an additional [[Gungan crystal]], which gives the blade a bubble effect.
